**Evaluating API endpoints**

I’m considering how to provide a comprehensive list of API symbols and line functions. For instance, "server surface" relates to routing endpoints and protocols. I think of the APIV1 Memo service, including checks and filters for reading and building memo searches. There are other concerns, like memo comments, attachments, and different frontend elements like RSS or SSE. It seems like I need to pinpoint at least seven kinds and cite the relevant function names precisely.

h15.
`APIV1Service.checkMemoReadAccess` (used by memo reads) — [server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:39](/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go#L39)  
`APIV1Service.ListMemos` visibility query filter — [server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:178](/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go#L178)  
`APIV1Service.ListMemoComments` access check and visibility filter — [server/router/api/v1/memo_service_comments.go:136](/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service_comments.go#L136)  
`APIV1Service.ListMemoRelations` visibility filter — [server/router/api/v1/memo_relation_service.go:93](/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_relation_service.go#L93)  
`APIV1Service.checkAttachmentAccess` (linked attachments inherit memo visibility) — [server/router/api/v1/attachment_service.go:419](/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/attachment_service.go#L419)  
`FileServerService.checkAttachmentPermission` (HTTP attachment downloads) — [server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:649](/bench/repo/server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go#L649)  
`RSSService.GetExploreRSS` / `GetUserRSS` (public-only queries) — [server/router/rss/rss.go:72](/bench/repo/server/router/rss/rss.go#L72)  
`FrontendService.getSitemapXML` (public-only query) — [server/router/frontend/frontend.go:143](/bench/repo/server/router/frontend/frontend.go#L143)  
`SSEClient.canReceive` (private-memo event filtering) — [server/router/api/v1/sse_hub.go:134](/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/sse_hub.go#L134)
